subject: Procurement intake + vendor setup (Acme Analytics)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement intake + vendor setup (Acme Analytics)

Hi Sarah —

Great to speak earlier today. Quick recap and next steps to keep procurement moving on your side: 

1) Vendor setup packet: I attached our standard vendor packet and W-9. Please confirm receipt and let me know if your vendor portal needs any additional fields (banking details, ACH vs wire routing, tax ID format).

2) Commercial path: You mentioned procurement prefers PO for larger contracts and card for pilot purchases. We accept both: PO via our billing portal (we will provide an invoice and remit-to details) and card via the self-serve checkout. If you plan to use PO, please confirm the procurement contact and whether you need our standard PO terms or a fully-executed SOW/contract.

3) Marketplace interest: You asked about marketplace options — we are listed on the AWS Marketplace and can provide an AWS SaaS contract path if procurement prefers it. That can simplify purchase order processing for some finance teams.

4) DocuSign / vendor portal: If you'd like to get vendor setup done quickly, here's a DocuSign link for our vendor packet: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234

Next steps (proposed):
- Sarah: confirm procurement contact + preferred payment method (PO vs card) — reply with contact name & email
- Tom: if you need custom banking instructions or a W-8 instead of W-9, flag that here
- Marissa: I will follow up with an invoice template and the vendor portal steps once I have the procurement contact

Attached: redwood_vendor_packet.pdf, Redwood_W-9_2026.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.
—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@acmeanalytics.com>

Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement intake + vendor setup (Acme Analytics)

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary.

Quick answers:
- Procurement contact: Tom Alvarez (tom.alvarez@acmeanalytics.com). He owns vendor setup and will push PO requests through Coupa.
- Payment method: For the initial pilot (under $5k) we can use card, but long-term we will do PO for committed monthly reserved capacity.
- Marketplace: Procurement is open to AWS Marketplace if the pricing/commitment model matches. Please send marketplace SKU info if available.

I attached our standard PO terms (acme_po_terms.pdf) for your legal team to review.

Could you send the invoice template and the exact remit-to / banking instructions that procurement needs to create the vendor record? Also confirm if you require a completed vendor questionnaire in addition to the packet you attached.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Tom will be the point of contact for the paperwork.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Chen
Director, IT Procurement
Acme Analytics

Hi Tom / Sarah —

Thanks — looping in Rishi (finance) and Dylan (solutions) so they have visibility.

Tom — attached is a short invoice template and our remit-to / banking instructions section you can paste into Coupa: 
- Company name: Redwood Inference Inc.
- Tax ID: 12-3456789
- Remit via ACH: Redwood Inference, Inc. / Bank: First West Bank / Routing: 111000025 / Account: 987654321
- Remit via wire: First West Bank / ABA: 011000138 / Acc: 987654321 / Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.

If your tax team needs a W-8 instead of a W-9, let me know and I can coordinate with our tax folks — otherwise W-9 is attached. We do also have a short vendor questionnaire; I included the vendor packet that contains those fields. If Coupa requires custom fields we can provide values on request.

Regarding the commercial path:
- For POs: we issue invoices on a net-30 standard term (we can discuss net-45/60 if needed during contracting).
- For pilot card purchases: no paperwork required beyond a credit card transaction.
- AWS Marketplace: I can route you to the marketplace SKU and pricing; Dylan, can you include the marketplace SKU and any difference in billing flow?

DocuSign link to complete the vendor packet (most customers find this fastest): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234

Attached: acme_invoice_template.pdf, redwood_vendor_packet.pdf, Redwood_W-9_2026.pdf

Marissa
